guide.title: A week in San Francisco
guide.author: Nate Bird
guide.summary: Seven days of cable cars and fog, dim sum and burritos, bay crossings and big parks, from the Ferry Building to Lands End.

places.name: Fairmont San Francisco
places.notes: The grand hotel on top of Nob Hill, with cable cars at the door and a tiki bar in the basement.

places.name: Palace Hotel
places.address: 2 New Montgomery St, San Francisco, CA 94105
places.notes: Have a drink under the glass dome of the Garden Court, even if you stay somewhere else.

places.name: Hotel Drisco
places.notes: A quiet 1903 hotel in Pacific Heights, with breakfast and views over the bay.

places.name: Hotel Zephyr
places.notes: A playful nautical hotel at the wharf, handy for the Alcatraz ferry and the cable cars.

places.name: Swan Oyster Depot
places.notes: A marble counter, a few stools and the best crab and oysters in town. Lunch only, cash only, always a line.

places.name: Tadich Grill
places.notes: Open since 1849. Sit at the counter and order the cioppino.

places.name: Hog Island Oyster Co.
places.notes: Tomales Bay oysters with a view of the Bay Bridge. Get there before noon.

places.name: La Taqueria
places.notes: The Mission burrito, no rice. Order it dorado style, crisped on the grill.

places.name: Tartine Bakery
places.notes: Morning buns and country bread worth the queue. Then carry them to Dolores Park.

places.name: Zuni Café
places.notes: The roast chicken with bread salad takes an hour, so order it when you sit down.

places.name: House of Prime Rib
places.address: 1906 Van Ness Ave, San Francisco, CA 94109
places.notes: Prime rib carved tableside from silver carts since 1949. Book ahead.

places.name: State Bird Provisions
places.notes: Small plates rolled past on carts, dim sum style. Fun, and different every night.

places.name: Nopa
places.notes: A big, lively room serving wood-fired California food late into the night.

places.name: Good Mong Kok Bakery
places.notes: Takeout dim sum by the box. Har gow and pork buns for a few dollars.

places.name: Mama's on Washington Square
places.notes: A North Beach breakfast institution. The line moves, and the French toast is worth it.

places.name: Liguria Bakery
places.notes: Focaccia only, since 1911, until it sells out. Go before 11.

places.name: Burma Superstar
places.notes: Burmese food on Clement Street. The tea leaf salad is a must.

places.name: Mitchell's Ice Cream
places.address: 688 San Jose Ave, San Francisco, CA 94110
places.notes: Tropical flavors like ube and mango since 1953. Take a number.

places.name: Sightglass Coffee
places.notes: A big, airy roastery in SoMa. Watch the roasting from the mezzanine.

places.name: Vesuvio Cafe
places.notes: The Beat poets' bar, across Jack Kerouac Alley from City Lights Books.

places.name: The Buena Vista
places.notes: Where Irish coffee came to America. Watch the bartenders line up a dozen at a time.

places.name: Trick Dog
places.notes: Inventive cocktails in the Mission, with a menu that changes theme twice a year.

places.name: Alcatraz Island
places.notes: The audio tour of the old prison is excellent. Book the ferry from Pier 33 weeks ahead.

places.name: Golden Gate Bridge
places.address: Golden Gate Bridge, San Francisco, CA 94129
places.notes: Walk or bike across, at least to the first tower. Bring a jacket, whatever the season.

places.name: Ferry Building Marketplace
places.notes: Local food under one roof. Come on a Saturday morning for the farmers market.

places.name: Cable Car Museum
places.notes: A free museum inside the working powerhouse that pulls every cable car in the city.

places.name: Coit Tower
places.address: 1 Telegraph Hill Blvd, San Francisco, CA 94133
places.notes: 1930s murals and a 360-degree view. Walk down the Filbert Steps afterwards.

places.name: San Francisco Museum of Modern Art
places.notes: Seven floors of modern art. The ground floor galleries are free.

places.name: Asian Art Museum
places.notes: One of the largest collections of Asian art in the West, in the old main library.

places.name: de Young Museum
places.address: 50 Hagiwara Tea Garden Dr, San Francisco, CA 94118
places.notes: American art and textiles in Golden Gate Park. The tower's observation floor is free.

places.name: California Academy of Sciences
places.address: 55 Music Concourse Dr, San Francisco, CA 94118
places.notes: A rainforest, an aquarium and a planetarium under a living roof.

places.name: Legion of Honor
places.notes: European art and Rodin's Thinker, on a cliff above the Golden Gate.

places.name: Exploratorium
places.address: Pier 15, The Embarcadero, San Francisco, CA 94111
places.notes: Hundreds of hands-on science exhibits on a pier. Thursday nights are adults only.

places.name: Musée Mécanique
places.notes: A free hall of antique arcade machines. Bring quarters.

places.name: Mission Dolores
places.notes: The oldest building in the city, finished in 1791, with a small cemetery and garden.

places.name: Golden Gate Fortune Cookie Factory
places.notes: Watch fortune cookies folded by hand in a narrow Chinatown alley. Bring cash.

places.name: Golden Gate Park
places.address: Golden Gate Park, San Francisco, CA 94122
places.notes: Three miles of gardens, lakes and bison. Rent a bike and ride it all the way to the ocean.

places.name: Japanese Tea Garden
places.address: 75 Hagiwara Tea Garden Dr, San Francisco, CA 94118
places.notes: The oldest public Japanese garden in the country. Go early, and have tea in the teahouse.

places.name: Lands End Lookout
places.address: 680 Point Lobos Ave, San Francisco, CA 94121
places.notes: A coastal trail with views of the Golden Gate, ending at the ruins of the Sutro Baths.

places.name: Crissy Field
places.notes: A flat bayside walk from the Marina to the foot of the Golden Gate Bridge.

places.name: Mission Dolores Park
places.notes: The city's favorite lawn on a sunny afternoon, with a skyline view from the top.

places.name: Alamo Square
places.notes: The Painted Ladies with downtown behind them. Bring a picnic.

places.name: Twin Peaks
places.address: 501 Twin Peaks Blvd, San Francisco, CA 94114
places.notes: The whole city at your feet. Go on a clear morning before the fog rolls in.

places.name: Muir Woods National Monument
places.address: 1 Muir Woods Rd, Mill Valley, CA 94941
places.notes: Old-growth redwoods half an hour north. Parking or shuttle must be booked ahead.
